svg.title: Day 5: Tabo, Dhankar, Lhalung and the Pin valley
svg.desc: The Spiti valley from Tabo to the Pin confluence at Attargo, the turn-offs to Dhankar and Lhalung, and up the Pin valley past Kungri to Mud. Places: Tabo, Dhankar (village, old gompa and lake: see close-up), Shichilling, Lhalung, Attargo, Sagnam, Guling, Kungri, Mud.
